data.name: Kassander
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'kassanos', meaning 'executor of a man's will'. In Greek mythology, Kassander was a Macedonian nobleman who became the regent for his nephew, Alexander IV, and later seized the throne for himself.

In the Christian context, this name can inspire individuals to be ambitious in their pursuits, but to also exercise their power and influence in a manner that respects the will of God and serves the greater good.

Just as Kassander was the executor of another's will, we are all called to be the stewards of God's creation and to carry out His plans for our lives. This name can encourage individuals to seek God's guidance in all their endeavors and to strive to live in accordance with His values and teachings.
